scripts.build: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('./quickfix_backend')) { require('child_process').execSync('npm install --prefix quickfix_backend --production=false', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('npm install --production=false', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('./quickfix_backend')) { require('child_process').execSync('npm install --prefix quickfix_backend --production=false', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('npm install --production=false', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"
scripts.start: node -e "const dir = require('fs').existsSync('./quickfix_backend') ? './quickfix_backend' : '.'; const file = require('path').resolve(dir, 'server.js'); process.chdir(dir); require(file);"
